decisions.subject: CT-1051
decisions.summary: CT-1051 CAN transceiver enters bus-off during cold-start inrush; firmware never requests bus-off recovery, so telemetry stays down

evidence.quote: Logs show the CT-1051 CAN transceiver entering bus-off during the cold-start inrush.
The firmware never requests bus-off recovery, so telemetry stays down.

decisions.subject: CT-1051
decisions.summary: Proposed adding automatic bus-off recovery with a watchdog that re-initialises the CT-1051 after 3 missed heartbeats, to ship in Firmware 2.4

evidence.quote: We can add automatic bus-off recovery with a watchdog that re-initialises the CT-1051 after 3 missed heartbeats.
